title: Lifting crystalline extension classes in large weight: Kisin modules with exponents, cokernel killers and cup products that vanish up to a power of p
summary: For crystalline lattices over a Kummer chart of p-adic Hodge theory, the unit measures, at each Frobenius translate φ^a(E) of the Eisenstein element, the exponents of elements of Kisin modules (withExponents), deepens them by Galois operators (g − 1)/(zτ) at an explicit cost in p, and finds annihilators p^κE^s of the cokernels of Kisin modules of crystalline extensions (KillsCokernel). A walk along Frobenius orbits then makes the cup product of two crystalline classes a coboundary after multiplication by an explicit power of p independent of the rank (ScaledCupBounds), for weights in a low and a far window and through a long-gap lemma (chunk a); chunk b (FewLowJumps, SparseThickLetters, ExponentTheorems) turns this into the length bound for classes with few low weights and the exponent for tame types used in the Selmer bound.

lemma wittFst_smul : ∀ x, S.wittFst (n • x) =
  n • S.wittFst x + S.trivLattice.wittMap S.kerLattice (.fst .. ∘ₗ extensionRep S.α (snd n) ∘ₗ
  .inr ..) (n • S.projTriv.wittMap x)
members.text: For a side S, n = (a, g) ∈ ℤ × Γ (acting on W(C^♭)⊗(·) by φ^a j(g) ⊗ g) and x ∈ W(C^♭)⊗Ỹ: wittFst(S, n·x) = n·wittFst(S, x) + wittMap(trivLattice(S), kerLattice(S), fst ∘ extensionRep(α)(g) ∘ inr)(n·projTriv(S)(x)), i.e. the Y-component of n·x is n times the Y-component of x plus the cocycle term e ↦ α(e)(g) applied to n times the C-component.

lemma Pairing.ScaledCupBounds.of_isSafe {e₁ e₂ e₃ c c'} x w x' (he : e₁ + e₂ + e₃ ≤ e) (hx :
  S.projTriv.wittMap x = p ^ e₁ • .mk 1 c) (hw : S.projTriv.wittMap w = p ^ e₁ • .mk 1 c) (hx' :
  S'.projTriv.wittMap x' = p ^ e₂ • .mk 1 c') (H : ∀ g : k.galMonoid, (∀ h :
  k.galMonoid, P.IsSafe e₃ (g • x - x) (g • (h • x' - x'))) ∧ P.IsSafe e₃ (w - x) (g • x' - x') ∧
  P.IsSafe e₃ (g • w - w) (g • (φ • x' - x')) ∧ P.IsSafe e₃ (φ • x - w) (g • φ • x' - φ • x')) :
  P.ScaledCupBounds e c c'
members.text: Let p, Γ, the Kummer chart k (with subgroup Γ' and Frobenius φ ∈ ℤ × Γ) and O be as in the setting, S, S' sides, P a pairing of Y and Y' modulo p^m, e, e₁, e₂, e₃ ∈ ℕ with e₁ + e₂ + e₃ ≤ e (he), c ∈ C and c' ∈ C'. Let x, w ∈ W(C^♭)⊗Ỹ lie over p^{e₁}c: projTriv(S)(x) = projTriv(S)(w) = p^{e₁}·(1 ⊗ c) (hx, hw), and x' ∈ W(C^♭)⊗Ỹ' over p^{e₂}c': projTriv(S')(x') = p^{e₂}·(1 ⊗ c') (hx'). Suppose (H) that for every g in galMonoid(k) = {(0, g) : g ∈ Γ'}: IsSafe(P, e₃, gx − x, g(hx' − x')) for every h ∈ galMonoid(k); IsSafe(P, e₃, w − x, gx' − x'); IsSafe(P, e₃, gw − w, g(φx' − x')); and IsSafe(P, e₃, φx − w, gφx' − φx'). Then ScaledCupBounds(P, e, c, c') holds.

members.text: For a lattice datum L, a letter i and an exponent function c : ℕ → ℤ → ℤ: withExponents(L, i, c) is the A_inf-submodule of W(C^♭) ⊗ L of the x that lie in kisinLocAinf(L) (the Kisin module over A_inf with all φ^a E inverted) and in letterPart(L, i) (ζ acts as the Teichmüller lift ω(i)), and satisfy: for every a ∈ ℕ, every u ∈ U_{σ^{−a}(i)} and every form μ ∈ formsOfType(L, σ^{−a}(i), u), valueAt(L, a, μ, x) = μ(φ^{−a}x) lies in hodgeFil(c(a, u)) = t^{c(a,u)}B_dR^+; σ^{−a}(i) = stepBack(i, a) is the letter a steps before i.

members.statement_lean:
lemma KummerChart.few_low_jumps (hk : IsUnramified) (hp : 5 ≤ p) {a η W} {b : _ → ℕ} {ε : _ →
  _} (ha : ∀ n, b n + W + η ≤ (p - 3) * a) (hη : 1 ≤ η) (hb : ∀ n, 6 * (a + η + W) < b n) (hs : ∀ n,
  NoMultipleNear p (6 * (a + η + W)) (b n)) (hL : InClass ⊤ ⊥ U' L) (hV : ∀ i, IsInJumpWindow η
  (-ε i) (b i) W (k.letterJumps ζ U i) ∧ IsInJumpWindow η (ε i) (b i) W (k.letterJumps ζ U' i)) :
  ((∀ g u, u ∈ U g ∨ u ∈ U' g → u ∉ Ico (-↑a) 0) ∨ (∀ g, U' g ⊆ Icc (-η) 0) → crysCocycles L.ρ ≤
  cupOrthogonal (InClass ⊤ ⊥ U) L) ∧ ∀ m, (∀ g, ∑ u ∈ Icc (-↑η) ↑η, jump L.ρ g u ≤ m) →
  relLength (crysCocycles L.ρ) (cupOrthogonal (InClass ⊤ ⊥ U) L) ≤
  ↑(11 * (k.f * (m * (a + 1) + finrank O L * (W + 1)))) * length O (O ⧸ Ideal.span {(p : O)})
members.text: Length bound for crystalline classes with few low weights. Let j : Γ → G_p be an open embedding (ho), O a p-adic integer ring, L a lattice over O, U, U' jump sets indexed by the embeddings O → C_p, k an unramified Kummer chart (hk) with residue degree f, ζ ∈ O with ζ^(p^f − 1) = 1, p ≥ 5 (hp), a, η, W ∈ ℕ, b : letters → ℕ, ε : letters → ℤ^×, with b(i) + W + η ≤ (p − 3)a (ha), η ≥ 1 (hη), 6(a + η + W) < b(i) (hb) and NoMultipleNear(p, 6(a + η + W), b(i)) (hs) for every letter i, L in InClass(⊤, ⊥, U') (hL), and letterJumps(k, ζ, U, i) in [−η, η] ∪ (−ε(i))[b(i), b(i) + W], letterJumps(k, ζ, U', i) in [−η, η] ∪ ε(i)[b(i), b(i) + W] for every i (hV). Then: (1) if no u ∈ U(g) ∪ U'(g) lies in [−a, 0) for any g, or U'(g) ⊆ [−η, 0] for every g, then Z_f(L) ⊆ cupOrthogonal(InClass(⊤, ⊥, U), L); (2) for every m with Σ_{u∈[−η, η]} jump(L, g, u) ≤ m for every g: relLength(Z_f(L), cupOrthogonal(InClass(⊤, ⊥, U), L)) ≤ 11·f·(m(a + 1) + rank_O(L)·(W + 1))·length_O(O/pO), relLength(S, T) being the O-length of S/(S ∩ T). Conclusion (2) does not assume the alternative of (1).

literature.verdict: The Artin–Schreier–Witt sequence explains Frobenius surjectivity. The complete small-ideal and continuity package is unlocated in Herr.
literature.comparison: Let Γ lie over G_p with open image, m≥0, and ρ be a Z_p-representation with (ρ(h)−1)y∈p^mT near 1 for each y. Fix a W(C♭)-linear map L from the diagonal tensor of ρ to M=W(C♭)⊗Z/p^m(1). Here S is the image of W(𝔪♭)·(1⊗1). The header continues after its local definition of S. It gives p^m M=0, surjectivity of φ−1, (φ−1)d∈S implying d is a scalar modulo S, injectivity of the scalar copy modulo S, and for every v the estimate L(hv−v)∈S near 1. Illusie §2.7, (2.7.1), gives the exact Artin–Schreier–Witt sequence for truncated Witt vectors in the étale topology. On an algebraically closed tilt this yields the Frobenius assertion for m≥1, and m=0 is trivial. Herr §2, Theorem 2.1, computes continuous Galois cohomology from an étale (φ,Γ)-module complex. Neither passage gives the entire assertion for this S and arbitrary L. The remaining comparison must track the ideal and its scalars in the Witt-vector quotient, and the estimate used separately at PeriodRings/BdR.lean:37 and KisinModuleDefs.lean:114–124.

L. Illusie, Complexe de de Rham-Witt, Astérisque 63 (1979), §2.7, Artin–Schreier–Witt sequence (2.7.1) <https://www.numdam.org/article/AST_1979__63__83_0.pdf>

  isChartOf : chart.IsChartOf (toGp.comp Γ'.subtype)
  nearOne_le : nearOne Γ ≤ .map Γ'.subtype ⊤
  exists_smul_z l : ∃ g : Γ', toGp g.1 • chart.z.1 = teichmuller p epsTilt ^ l * chart.z
imports.text: A Kummer chart for Γ: a chart (a Λ-algebra map Λ[[X]] → A_inf, Λ = W(F_{p^f}), X ↦ z = [u] a non-unit Teichmüller lift, X^eA + p ↦ ξ·unit) with a subgroup Γ' of Γ of index prime to p, containing the elements near 1, such that j(Γ') fixes θ(z) and is the fixer of the chart's field, and for every l ≥ 0 some g ∈ Γ' has g·z = [ε]^l·z.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.differentExp
imports.lean: def Lift.KummerChart.differentExp := if k.e = 1 then 0 else padicValNat p k.e + 1
imports.text: d = 0 if the index e of the chart is 1, and d = v_p(e) + 1 otherwise.

imports.name: Lift.Chart.S
imports.lean: def S := c.seriesMap.range
imports.text: For a chart, the Λ-subalgebra S of A_inf, the image of the chart's map Λ[[X]] → A_inf.

imports.name: Lift.Chart.z
imports.lean: def z : c.S := ⟨c.seriesMap X, _, rfl⟩
imports.text: The coordinate z ∈ S of a chart, the image of X.

imports.name: Lift.Chart.E
imports.lean: @[irreducible, local simp] def E := c.z ^ c.e * c.seriesEquiv c.unitSeries + p
imports.text: The element E = z^e·A(z) + p of S (the image of the chart's series); it equals ξ times a unit of A_inf.

imports.name: Lift.Chart.φ
imports.lean:
def φ : c.S →+* c.S :=
  (frobEnd.comp c.S.val.1).codRestrict _ (let F := c.seriesMap.comp (expand p out)
  have := isAdicComplete_span_singleton (a := F X) (by simp [F, c.4])
  (⟨_, mem_range_of_approx F.toAddMonoidHom (F.toSemilinearMap.2 X) _ (c.exists_z_dvd_sub_const ·
  |>.rec fun a ⟨t, e⟩ ↦ (a.exists_smul_algebraMap_eq _).imp' C fun _ _ ↦ ⟨t, by
  simpa [F, e, C_eq_algebraMap, z, seriesMap_X]⟩) · |>.choose_spec⟩))
imports.text: The Frobenius endomorphism φ of S (restriction of the Frobenius of A_inf).

imports.name: Lift.Chart.frobE
imports.lean: def frobE n := (c.φ ^ n) c.E
imports.text: p_n = φ^n(E) ∈ S.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.frobEUnit
imports.lean: def frobEUnit := (isUnit_WittCFlat_of_not_p_dvd (p_not_dvd_frobE a)).unit
imports.text: φ^a(E) as a unit of W(C^♭) (p does not divide φ^a(E)).

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.zTau
imports.lean: def zTau := tau * k.z
imports.text: δ = zτ ∈ A_inf, τ = [ε^{1/p}] − 1.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.zTauUnit
imports.lean:
def zTauUnit :=
  (isUnit_WittCFlat_of_not_p_dvd (Ainf.prime_p.not_dvd_mul not_p_dvd_tau k.not_p_dvd_z)).unit
imports.text: zτ as a unit of W(C^♭) (p divides neither z nor τ).

imports.name: tau
imports.lean: def tau : Ainf := teichmuller p epsRoot - 1

imports.name: Ainf
imports.lean: abbrev Ainf := WittVector p OFlat
imports.text: A_inf = W(O^♭), the p-typical Witt vectors of the tilt of O_{C_p}.

imports.name: WittCFlat
imports.lean: @[instance_reducible] def WittCFlat := WittVector p CFlat deriving CommRing, IsDomain
imports.text: W(C^♭), the p-typical Witt vectors of the fraction field C^♭ of O^♭.

imports.name: BdR
imports.lean: @[instance_reducible] def BdR := FractionRing BdRPlus deriving Field
imports.text: The de Rham period field B_dR, the fraction field of B_dR^+.

imports.name: hodgeFil
imports.lean: noncomputable def hodgeFil (n : ℤ) := BdRPlus ∙ (tUnit ^ n).1
imports.text: hodgeFil(n) = t^n·B_dR^+, the n-th step of the filtration of B_dR.

imports.name: hodgeFil_anti
imports.lean: lemma hodgeFil_anti : Antitone hodgeFil := antitone_int_of_succ_le (by simp [← mul_self_zpow])
imports.text: The filtration is decreasing: n ≤ m implies hodgeFil(m) ⊆ hodgeFil(n).

imports.name: Lift.phiInvToBdR
imports.lean:
noncomputable def Lift.phiInvToBdR a := (algebraMap _ BdR).comp
    (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom _ Ainf (φ ^ a)⁻¹)
imports.text: The ring map A_inf → B_dR, φ^{−a} followed by the structure map.

imports.name: Lift.thetaPhiInv
imports.lean: noncomputable def Lift.thetaPhiInv := theta.comp ((ofBijective _ frobEnd_bijective)⁻¹ ^ n).toRingHom
imports.text: The ring map θ ∘ φ^{−n} : A_inf → O_C.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.valueField
imports.lean:
noncomputable def Lift.KummerChart.valueField a := IntermediateField.adjoin (localFieldOf Γ')
    (.range fun x : k.bicommutant × k.S ↦ algebraMap _ _ x.1 * phiInvToBdR a x.2)
imports.text: 𝒦_a ⊂ B_dR: the field generated over the fixed field K' of Γ' by the images of S_B and φ^{−a}S.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.phiInvToBdR_mem_valueField
imports.lean:
lemma phiInvToBdR_mem_valueField (s : k.S) : phiInvToBdR a s ∈ valueField a :=
  IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ ⟨(1, s), by simp⟩
imports.text: For s ∈ S, φ^{−a}(s) (in B_dR) lies in 𝒦_a.

imports.name: Lift.saturateBy
imports.lean:
def saturateBy (M : Submonoid R) (P : Submodule R X) := ((torsion' _ _ M).comap P.mkQ).copy
  {x | ∃ r ∈ M, r • x ∈ P} (by simp [← Quotient.mk_smul])
imports.text: The saturation of a submodule P by a submonoid M: the x with m·x ∈ P for some m ∈ M.

imports.name: Lift.le_saturateBy
imports.lean: lemma le_saturateBy {M x} (h : x ∈ Q) : x ∈ saturateBy M Q := ⟨1, by simpa⟩
imports.text: P is contained in its saturation.

imports.name: Lift.mem_saturateBy_of_smul
imports.lean:
lemma mem_saturateBy_of_smul {M r s x} (d : r ∣ s) (h : s ∈ M) : r • x ∈ saturateBy M Q → x ∈
  saturateBy M Q := fun ⟨a, _⟩ ↦ ⟨a * s, by grind [dvd_def, mul_smul, smul_comm, smul_mem, mul_mem]⟩
imports.text: If r divides s ∈ M and r·x is in the saturation, then x is in the saturation.

imports.name: Lift.saturateBy_induction
imports.lean:
@[elab_as_elim] lemma saturateBy_induction {ι x} {f : ι → R} {C : X → Prop} (hx : x ∈ saturateBy
  (.closure (range f)) Q) (h₀ : ∀ x ∈ Q, C x) (h₁ : ∀ a x, C (f a • x) → C x) : C x := by
  obtain ⟨_, hr, _⟩ := hx
  induction hr using Submonoid.closure_induction_right generalizing x <;> grind [mul_smul, one_smul]
imports.text: Induction over the saturation by the monoid generated by f(ι): a property holding on P and passing from f(a)·x to x holds on the saturation.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.ainfLattice
imports.lean: def ainfLattice := span Ainf (M := L.Ambient) (range (DiagTensor.mk 1))
imports.text: ainfLattice(L): the A_inf-span of the 1 ⊗ y, y ∈ L, in W(C^♭)⊗L.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.fracSpan
imports.lean: abbrev fracSpan := saturateBy (nonZeroDivisors _) L.ainfLattice
imports.text: fracSpan(L): the x ∈ W(C^♭)⊗L that some nonzero element of A_inf multiplies into ainfLattice(L).

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.forms
imports.lean: def forms := {μ : L.Functional | ∀ t (g : k.Γ'), μ (.mk 1 (L.ρ g t)) = toGp g.1 • μ (.mk 1 t)}
imports.text: forms(L): the A_inf-linear μ : W(C^♭)⊗L → B_dR with μ(1 ⊗ gt) = g·μ(1 ⊗ t) for g ∈ Γ'.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.kisinAinf
imports.lean:
def kisinAinf := saturateBy (.powers tau) L.ainfLattice ⊓ ⟨⟨⟨{x | ∀ n, ∀ μ ∈ L.forms, μ (φ ^ (n + 1)
  • x) ∈ hodgeFil 0}, by aesop⟩, by simp⟩, by simp_all [frobGroup_smul_smul, smul_of_tower_mem]⟩
imports.text: kisinAinf(L) = M: the x in the saturation of ainfLattice(L) by the powers of τ with μ(φ^{n+1}x) ∈ B_dR^+ for all n ≥ 0 and μ ∈ forms(L).

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.kisinLocAinf
imports.lean: def kisinLocAinf := saturateBy (.closure (range (k.frobE · |>.1))) L.kisinAinf
imports.text: kisinLocAinf(L): the x ∈ W(C^♭)⊗L that some finite product of the φ^a(E) multiplies into kisinAinf(L) (M with all φ^a E inverted).

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.valueFieldPoints
imports.lean:
def valueFieldPoints (Q : Submodule Ainf L.Ambient) : Submodule k.S L.Ambient := ⟨⟨⟨{x ∈ Q | ∀ μ ∈
  forms, μ x ∈ valueField 0}, by aesop⟩, by simp⟩, fun s _ ↦ .imp (smul_mem _ _) (by
  simpa [phiInvToBdR, smul_def'] using! mul_mem (phiInvToBdR_mem_valueField s) <| · · ·)⟩
imports.text: For an A_inf-submodule Q: the S-module of the x ∈ Q with μ(x) ∈ 𝒦_0 for every μ ∈ forms(L).

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.kisinLoc
imports.lean: def kisinLoc := L.valueFieldPoints kisinLocAinf
imports.text: kisinLoc(L) = 𝒩: the x ∈ kisinLocAinf(L) with μ(x) ∈ 𝒦_0 for every μ ∈ forms(L), an S-module (the Kisin module with all φ^a E inverted).

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.letterOp
imports.lean: def letterOp := k.letterTeich i⁻¹ • L.mulZeta.wittMap
imports.text: The endomorphism ω(i)⁻¹ζ of W(C^♭)⊗L.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.letterPart
imports.lean: def letterPart := (L.letterOp i - 1).ker.restrictScalars Ainf
imports.text: letterPart(L, i): the A_inf-submodule of W(C^♭)⊗L on which ζ acts as the Teichmüller lift ω(i).

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.letterProj
imports.lean: def letterProj := ⅟(card Letter : ℤ_[p]) • ∑ n ∈ .range (card Letter), L.letterOp i ^ n
imports.text: letterProj(L, i) = q⁻¹Σ_{n<q}(ω(i)⁻¹ζ)^n, q = p^f − 1: the projection to the letter i.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.formsOfType
imports.lean: def formsOfType := {μ ∈ L.forms | ∀ t, μ (L.letterProj i (.mk 1 t)) ∈ hodgeFil (-u)}
imports.text: formsOfType(L, i, u): the μ ∈ forms(L) with μ(letterProj(L, i)(1 ⊗ t)) ∈ t^{−u}B_dR^+ for all t ∈ L.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.valueAt
imports.lean:
def valueAt (μ : L.Functional) : L.Ambient →ₛₗ[phiInvToBdR a] BdR :=
  ⟨μ.1.comp (semilinearAct (φ ^ a)⁻¹).1, by simp [phiInvToBdR, smul_def']⟩
imports.text: valueAt(L, a, μ, x) = μ(φ^{−a}x), semilinear along φ^{−a} : A_inf → B_dR.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.Letter
imports.lean: def Letter := (flatFq k.f)ˣ deriving CommGroup, Finite, IsCyclic
imports.text: The letters: the units of the field with p^f elements in O^♭.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.Letter.stepBack
imports.lean: @[simp] abbrev Letter.stepBack := (k.letterFrob ^ a)⁻¹ i
imports.text: stepBack(i, a) = σ^{−a}(i): the image of i under the a-th power of the inverse of x ↦ x^p.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.stdExponent
imports.lean: @[grind] def stdExponent := if a < l then 0 else -u
imports.text: stdExponent(l, a, u) = 0 if a < l and −u if a ≥ l.

imports.name: Lift.Chart.coord₀
imports.lean: abbrev coord₀ := c.adicBasis.coord c.oneIndex
imports.text: λ₀ : A_inf → S, the chosen S-linear coordinate that is the identity on S.

imports.name: Lift.Chart.adicBasis
imports.lean: def adicBasis := c.exists_adicBasis_coord_eq_self.choose
imports.text: A chosen (p, z)-adic topological basis of A_inf over S with S-linear coordinates λ_i.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.frame_theorem
imports.lean:
lemma frame_theorem : ((∀ (f : _ →ₗ[k.S] k.S) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (v : ι → _) (c : ι → Ainf),
  (∀ i, v i ∈ L.valueFieldPoints fracSpan) → ∑ i, c i • v i = 0 → ∑ i, f (c i) • v i = 0) ∧ (∀ l A
  δ, 3 * k.e ≤ p ^ l → k.e * A ≤ p ^ l * δ → ∀ x ∈ L.valueFieldPoints (frobKisinAinf l), p ^ (4 * δ)
  • x ∈ span k.S {y ∈ L.valueFieldPoints (frobKisinAinf l) | ∀ μ ∈ forms, ∀ g : Γ', toGp g.1 • μ y -
  μ y ∈ hodgeFil A}) ∧ L.kisinAinf = span _ L.kisinModule ∧ (∀ μ ∈ crysForms, ∀ y ∈ L.kisinModule,
  ∃ s ∈ k.bicommutant, k.E.1 ^ L.jumpBound • μ y = algebraMap _ _ s) ∧ ∀ d, (∀ {m r}, ainfToBPlus
  d ∣ ainfToBPlus (k.E.1 ^ m * r) → d ∣ r) → ∀ x ∈ kisinAinf, (∀ μ ∈ L.crysForms, k.E.1 ^
  (2 * L.jumpBound) • μ x ∈ BPlus ∙ algebraMap _ _ d) → x ∈ d • kisinAinf) ∧ (∀ x ∈ kisinAinf, tau ^
  L.jumpBound • x ∈ L.ainfLattice) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ainfLattice, tau ^ L.jumpBound • x ∈ L.kisinAinf) ∧
  ∀ x ∈ L.kisinModule, k.frobEUnit 0 ^ L.jumpBound • FrobGroup.φ • x ∈ kisinModule := by
imports.text: Frame theorem (h the least bound of |jumps|): M = A_inf·N, τ^h M ⊆ A_inf⊗L, τ^h(A_inf⊗L) ⊆ M, E^h φN ⊆ N; S-linear maps A_inf → S preserve relations among valueFieldPoints; crystalline forms test divisibility in M; and a spanning statement for φ^l(M) up to p^{4δ} (Kisin lattice of a crystalline lattice, known result).

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.exists_derivative_dvd_p_pow
imports.lean:
lemma exists_derivative_dvd_p_pow : ∃ P : (WittFq k.f)[X], k.E ∣ aeval k.z P ∧
  theta (aeval k.z P.derivative).1 ∣ p ^ differentExp := by
imports.text: There is a polynomial P over Λ with E | P(z) in S and θ(P'(z)) | p^d, d = differentExp.

imports.name: Lift.Chart.associated_E_mul_tau_mu
imports.lean:
lemma associated_E_mul_tau_mu : Associated (c.E * tau) mu :=
  xi_mul_tau ▸ c.associated_E_xi.mul_right _
imports.text: E·τ is associated to μ = [ε] − 1 in A_inf.

imports.name: Lift.Chart.associated_smul_E
imports.lean:
lemma associated_smul_E g : Associated c.E.1 ((g : Gp p) • c.E) := (associated_smul_of_dvd g
  (by simp [c.associated_E_xi.dvd_iff_dvd_left, ← theta_eq_zero_iff_xi_dvd, theta_E])).symm
imports.text: For g ∈ G_p, g·E is associated to E.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.zTau_mul_E_dvd_smul_sub
imports.lean:
lemma zTau_mul_E_dvd_smul_sub (s : k.S) : zTau * k.E ∣ g • s - s := let ⟨_, g, rfl⟩ := g
  by obtain ⟨⟨h, hg⟩, _⟩ := fixes g, k.theta_z_ne_zero
     grw [zTau, mul_rotate, mul_assoc,
       k.associated_E_mul_tau_mu.dvd]; apply k.dvd_smul_sub_of_fixesLambda _ h
     erw [← theta_smul, k.z_eq_teichmuller, smul_teichmuller] at *
     cases untilt_dvd_iff.1 (by simpa using hg.symm.dvd)
     simp_all [mu_dvd_of_theta_frobEnd, mul_dvd_mul, ← mul_sub_one]
imports.text: For g ∈ galMonoid(k) and s ∈ S: zτE divides g·s − s in A_inf.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.zTau_dvd_phi_pow_smul
imports.lean:
lemma zTau_dvd_phi_pow_smul a : k.zTau ∣ φ ^ a • k.zTau := by simp [k.z_eq_teichmuller,
  phi_pow_smul, mul_dvd_mul, tau, sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one]
imports.text: zτ divides φ^a(zτ).

imports.name: Lift.Chart.dvd_smul_sub_of_fixesLambda
imports.lean:
lemma dvd_smul_sub_of_fixesLambda {d} (h : d ∣ g • c.z.1 - c.z) (k : FixesLambda c.f g) (s : c.S) :
  d ∣ g • s - s := have := isAdicComplete_span_singleton c.4
  (mem_range_of_approx (.mulLeft d) (mul_smul_comm (c.seriesMap X) _) (g • (↑) - (↑))
  (c.exists_z_dvd_sub_const · |>.rec fun a ⟨t, e⟩ ↦ (h.mul_right (g • t)).imp fun _ ↦ (⟨t, by
  simp [*, ← ·, sub_mul, z]⟩)) s).rec Dvd.intro
imports.text: If g ∈ G_p fixes Λ and d divides gz − z, then d divides gs − s for every s ∈ S.

imports.name: Lift.frobE_dvd_iff
imports.lean:
lemma Lift.frobE_dvd_iff {c : Lift.Chart} {n a} : (c.frobE n).1 ∣ a ↔
  thetaPhiInv n a = 0 := by erw [c.coe_φ_pow, theta_eq_zero_iff_xi_dvd,
  ← c.associated_E_xi.dvd_iff_dvd_left, inv_pow, ← map_dvd_iff_dvd_symm (_ : RingAut _)]; simp
imports.text: φ^n(E) divides a ∈ A_inf iff θφ^{−n}(a) = 0.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.not_frobE_dvd_zTau
imports.lean:
lemma not_frobE_dvd_zTau a : ¬↑(k.frobE a) ∣ k.zTau :=
  (·.trans (zTau_dvd_phi_pow_smul a)).mt (by simp)
imports.text: zτ is not divisible by φ^a(E).

imports.name: Lift.lifting_the_exponent
imports.lean:
lemma lifting_the_exponent {R} [CommRing R] {f : Ainf →+* R} (hf : Surjective f) x v {n}
    (hv : ¬IsUnit v) (h : v ∣ x - 1) (H : p * f (x - 1) * f v ∣ f (x - 1) ^ p) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    f (x ^ n - 1) ∣ p ^ padicValNat p n * f (x - 1) := by
  set s := ∑ i ∈ .range (n.divMaxPow p), x ^ i
  have ⟨y, H⟩ := hf.exists.1 (ZMod.exists_one_add_mul_pow_prime_pow_eq out
    (by gcongr) H (f s) (padicValNat p n))
  have := (@isUnit_of_dvd_sub _ _ _ (s + v * y) (n.divMaxPow p) (isAdicComplete_span_singleton hv)
    (by simp [Ainf.isUnit_iff_isUnit_constantCoeff, CharP.isUnit_natCast_iff out,
    p.not_dvd_divMaxPow out hn]) (by simp_all [s, ← Quotient.eq_zero_iff_dvd])).map f
  simp_all [s, mul_geom_sum, ← pow_mul]
imports.text: Lifting the exponent: for f : A_inf → R surjective, a non-unit v dividing x − 1 with p·f(x − 1)·f(v) | f(x − 1)^p, and n ≠ 0: f(x^n − 1) | p^{v_p(n)}·f(x − 1).

imports.name: Lift.Chart.theta_E
imports.lean: lemma theta_E : theta c.E = 0 := theta_eq_zero_iff_xi_dvd.2 c.associated_E_xi.dvd'

imports.name: Lift.Chart.smul_theta_of_fixesThetaZ
imports.lean:
lemma smul_theta_of_fixesThetaZ (h : c.FixesThetaZ g) (s : c.S) : g • theta s = theta s := by
  simpa [← theta_eq_zero_iff_xi_dvd, h] using (c.dvd_smul_sub_of_fixesLambda (d := xi) · h.1 s)
imports.text: If g fixes Λ and θ(z), then g fixes θ(s) for every s ∈ S.

imports.name: Lift.Chart.theta_z_dvd_p
imports.lean: lemma theta_z_dvd_p : theta c.z ∣ p := by grw [c.dvd_iff_coe_dvd.1 c.z_dvd_E_sub_p]; simp [theta_E]
imports.text: θ(z) divides p.

imports.name: tau_dvd_xi_sub_p
imports.lean:
lemma tau_dvd_xi_sub_p : tau ∣ xi - p :=
  tau_dvd_of_theta_frobEnd (by simpa [iterate_fixed] using theta_iterate_frobEnd_xi)
imports.text: τ divides ξ − p.

imports.name: Lift.Chart.exists_dvd_sub_sum_z_pow
imports.lean:
lemma exists_dvd_sub_sum_z_pow n {N} (e : p ^ n * c.e = N) s : ∃ w : Fin N → WittFq c.f, c.frobE n ∣
  s - ∑ i, w i • c.z ^ i.1 := by simpa [(degreeLT.basis ..).equivFun.exists_congr_left] using
  (c.weierstrass_division n e s).exists
imports.text: For n and N = p^n·e, every s ∈ S is congruent modulo φ^n(E) to Σ_{i<N} w_i z^i with w_i ∈ Λ.

imports.name: isPrimitiveRoot_untilt_epsPow
imports.lean:
lemma isPrimitiveRoot_untilt_epsPow s : IsPrimitiveRoot (epsPow s).untilt s.toAdd.den := by
  erw [← coe_submonoidClass_iff, (exists_tilt_lift_of_character ..).choose_spec] <;>
    simp [map_of_injective, RingHom.injective, EquivLike.injective, isPrimitiveRoot_exp_rat]
imports.text: For a rational s, the untilt of ε^s is a primitive root of unity of order the denominator of s.

imports.name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.smul_mem_kisinAinf
imports.lean:

literature.verdict: A filtered consequence of the degree-zero parts of Tate's two theorems.
literature.comparison: Let K be the fixed field of the open image j(Γ) in G_p, S any B_dR⁺-submodule of B_dR and x∈B_dR. If g x−x∈S for every g∈j(Γ), there is an a∈K with x−a∈S. Tate §3.3 gives C_p^G_K=K. For each nonzero power of χ the extension cut out by the character is a totally ramified Z_p-extension after finite base change, so his Theorem 2 gives C_p(n)^G_K=0 for n≠0. Colmez III.1 identifies B_dR⁺ as a discrete valuation ring with residue C_p and uniformizer t transforming by χ. A proper nonzero submodule of its fraction field is t^m B_dR⁺ for some integer m. If x lies outside S, its leading term below the cutoff is fixed in gr^n≃C_p(n), and hence must have degree zero. Subtract its residue a∈K. A remaining nonzero leading term below the cutoff would have positive degree, which is impossible. The same argument without a cutoff covers S=0, and S=B_dR is immediate. Only H⁰ of the two Tate theorems enters.
sources: J. Tate, p-Divisible Groups, Proceedings of a Conference on Local Fields (1967), §3.3, Theorems 1 and 2, p. 176 <https://math.bu.edu/people/jsweinst/AWS/Files/TatePDivisibleGroups.pdf>
P. Colmez, Théorie d’Iwasawa des représentations de de Rham d’un corps local, §III.1, B_dR⁺, its residue and the action on t <https://webusers.imj-prg.fr/~pierre.colmez/iwasawa-deRham.pdf>

imports.lean:
lemma exists_auerbach {K U A L ι} [Field K] [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [Module.Finite K U]
    [Fintype ι] {_ : TopologicalSpace A} [CompactSpace A] [NormedField L] (b : Basis ι K U) (ℓ : A →
    Dual K U) (h : ∀ v, (∀ a, ℓ a v = 0) → v = 0) (φ : K →+* L) (hc : ∀ v, Continuous fun a ↦ φ
    (ℓ a v)) : ∃ᵉ (S : ι → A) (z), (∀ k, coord z k = ℓ (S k)) ∧ ∀ a k, ‖φ (ℓ a (z k))‖ ≤ 1 := by
imports.text: A form of Auerbach's lemma (its relation to the literature: the second reader's, see `literature`): let U be a finite-dimensional vector space over a field K with a basis b, A a compact space, ℓ : A → U* a family of linear forms with only 0 as common zero (h), φ : K → L a ring homomorphism into a normed field with a ↦ φ(ℓ_a(v)) continuous for every v (hc). Then there are S : ι → A and a basis z of U (indexed like b) with coord_k(z) = ℓ_{S(k)} for every k and ‖φ(ℓ_a(z_k))‖ ≤ 1 for all a and k.

literature.verdict: A determinant-maximization extension of Auerbach's lemma with a prescribed compact separating family.
literature.comparison: The given forms belong to the algebraic dual over a field K embedded in a normed field L. Their evaluations vary continuously in a compact parameter. The conclusion chooses coordinates from these very forms and gives the bound for every form in the family. The familiar real or complex normed-space theorem gives a biorthogonal unit basis but does not assert this selection from a given family in these fields. Maximizing a nonzero determinant over tuples of the family proves the extension using a one-row replacement. I have not located that precise version in a published source.
sources: Schlumprecht, Course notes for Functional Analysis I, Theorem 1.5.1, the classical unit-basis statement and proof <https://people.tamu.edu/~t-schlumprecht/course_notes_math655_23c.pdf>

def cupOrthogonal [TopologicalSpace Γ] (𝒬 : GalLattice O Γ → Prop) L :=
  Submodule.mk ⟨⟨{c | ∀ Y (P : Pairing Y L), 𝒬 Y → ∀ a ∈ crysCocycles Y.ρ,
  P.CupBounds a c}, by simp_all [← Pi.add_def, add_mem]⟩, by simp [← Pi.zero_def]⟩ fun (o : O) ↦

A pairing P consists of m ∈ ℕ, an O-linear ψ : Y ⊗_O L → O(1), a Z_p-linear λ : O → Z_p and a crystalline cocycle c₃ of (Y ⊗ L)^∨(1) with p^m·c₃(g) = gψ − ψ; CupBounds(P, a, c) says that the 2-cochain (g, h) ↦ ζ_m(λ(ψ(a(g) ⊗ g·c(h))) mod p^m), whose values lie in the p^m-th roots of unity, is the coboundary of a continuous cochain Γ → Q̄_p^× (Γ acting through j); the primitive takes values in Q̄_p^×, not necessarily in the p^m-th roots of unity.

literature.comparison: The ring R is any commutative Z_p-algebra and T is an R-module with compatible Z_p action. For j:Γ→G_p of open image assume that fixed periods near 1 span B_max⊗T, and β_{s,0}=1 for every s with j(s) in inertia. The conclusion is that periods fixed by every g in Γ span B_max⊗T. For a finite-dimensional potentially crystalline G_K-representation, Fontaine's D_pcris is the union of period modules over finite extensions, with N=0. The Weil inertia action is ordinary descent inertia on these periods. If it is trivial, periods descend through the unramified part by Galois descent, giving D_cris of full dimension. Fontaine's comparison and descent are formulated in the finite-dimensional category. A published argument for arbitrary T and the compact B_max-spanning definition is missing.
